boards.hardware: ESP32-S31NRV16, ES8389, Waveshare 3.6-inch e-Paper (E), BQ27220, PCF85063, SC7A20
boards.identify: paper V2 board; 3.6-inch 400x600 six-color display on U1 (50 pins), H1 BS0 grounded
boards.flash_port: Type-C USB Serial/JTAG on GPIO33/34; hold BOOT (GPIO61) while connecting for download mode
boards.use: Offline board demo: six-color screen, speaker tone, microphone record/playback, keys, motor, LED and battery; no platform connection
